All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

## Rollback
- **Diagnosed:** v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history showed **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- **Rolled back:** The first rollback attempt to v2.3.0 only completed for us-east (orchestrator halted the rollout). A retry completed the rollout successfully across all regions.
- **Verified:** checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to ~0.2%.

## Incident
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api (on-call paged), documenting the health check failures on v2.3.1, the partial-then-completed rollback to v2.3.0, and the note that v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production — so any re-deploy of it will need change-manager approval.

Note: the incident creation timed out on first attempt, so I retried with the same idempotency key to prevent a duplicate incident from being opened.
